title: Pinegrove APIWorks
text:
Pinegrove APIWorks

use_case_summary:
Early-stage dev tools startup building an in-product code assistant and doc search. Mostly browser + server calls. Want easy self-serve hosted API with predictable per-token pricing. Priorities: low integration friction, token-cost control (batching + caching suggestions), and quick way to move to paid with invoice once ARR > $1k/mo.

notes:
- Lead origin: inbound signup + product trial (created 2026-02-18)
- Team: CTO (Ellen Park), 2 backend devs, 1 product designer; small infra team
- Procurement tone: "procurement-lite" — prefers credit card while under $1k/mo, will move to invoice once commit size justifies (they estimate ~$1.5k/mo in Q3).
- Quote from Ellen: "We love the latency numbers in the quickstart — but billing flexibility is a must. Can we get an invoice path and a small startup credit bump to finish the POC?"
- Requested: +$2,000 promotional credits (extend free trial) to finish 6-week POC; proposal: 60 days extension, apply if usage looks like production test.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller/high-throughput open models initially (cost focus) with runway to move to higher-capacity variants if latency/quality required.
- Latency/throughput targets: 100ms-500ms median token latency; 30-60 req/s peak for chat flows. Budget-conscious: looking to keep cost/unit low via batching/caching.
- Security: happy with SOC2 + SSO, asked about audit logs and retention controls (basic need only). No air-gapped requirement.
- Integrations: will use Node SDK; asked about webhook/websocket streaming examples and prompt templates for code assistant.
- Action items: Maya to send tailored pricing sheet, example invoice flow, and startup discount T&Cs; Diego to prepare optimization checklist (batching/caching suggestions) and short runbook for moving to Dedicated if/when throughput grows.
- Risers: If invoice path blocked -> likely pause commit and test alternate provider; if credit extension approved -> high chance to convert to $1k+/mo within 3 months.

timeline:
2026-02-18: inbound signup via hosted API free tier; created account (self-serve)
2026-02-22: AE outreach email + quick product intro; customer asked about billing options
2026-02-25: discovery call (30m) w/ Maya, Diego; demo of hosted SDK + streaming; noted cost sensitivity
2026-03-03: follow-up call; customer requested invoice path and startup discount details; asked for free credit extension
2026-03-04: legal sent standard terms link; Diego to confirm latency targets and model choices

next_step:
send-pricing-and-offer-2k-credit-extension; follow-up call week of 2026-03-09

blockers:
billing: would prefer invoice for >$1k but currently CC on file
approval: needs manager sign-off on startup discount
SLA questions: wants 99.9% for production

procurement_notes:
- Currently on CC (self-serve) but finance prefers invoice for payments > $1k/month.
- Asking about startup discount eligibility and formal process to get invoice (need W9 + PO).
- Wants clarity on billing cycles and uplift for overages.
